description.text: Department of Information Technology Department of Information Technology bases on the front line of technological fields and takes the higher vocational education as its entrance. Adapted to the development of computer, it trains senior specialized talented persons. This department owns many kinds of advanced labs. In addition, it cooperates with some other it companies to open up a series of sites for practice and cultivate a group of brilliant students in the field of hardware maintenance, software application, software development, multimedia technical application and so on . Fusing science and technology, feeling freedom.

duration.text: The Science and Technology at Qingdao Hismile College is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
